scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/data', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/data/departments_indicators.json', 'dist/data/departments_indicators.json'); fs.copyFileSync('src/data/communes_indicators.json', 'dist/data/communes_indicators.json')"
scripts.automation:agenda: tsx src/scripts/automation/fetch-an-agenda.ts && tsx src/scripts/automation/fetch-senat-agenda.ts && tsx src/scripts/automation/fetch-elysee-agenda.ts && npm run automation:senat-summary
scripts.automation:laws: tsx src/scripts/automation/fetch-laws.ts && tsx src/scripts/automation/fetch-live-laws.ts && tsx src/scripts/automation/law-summarizer.ts
scripts.automation:all: npm run automation:petitions; npm run automation:votes; npm run automation:agenda; npm run automation:laws; npm run automation:browseract; npm run automation:legal; npm run automation:weekly-stats
